David believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. David wrote down every idea in a small notebook. For example, the maid cleaned the hotel room before the guests arrived.

Anna and David are preparing a report about the park path. People around David often share different ideas about the park path. The experience taught David more than any book could. Safeguarding training is mandatory.

The park path looked quieter than usual that evening. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. What's more, a breathing exercise cooled the panic.
At first, David found it difficult to keep the habit. David thanked Anna for the honest advice. Anna always says that small steps matter more than big plans. A hot bath helps me relax after training.
